# fleetdm_certificate_authorities (Data Source)

Retrieves every certificate authority configured in FleetDM. This is a Fleet Premium feature.

~> **Note:** Fleet's list endpoint returns identity only, so this data source exposes `id`, `name` and `type` and no configuration. Fleet never returns certificate authority secrets through any endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every certificate authority configured in Fleet.
# Fleet's list endpoint returns identity only, so id, name and type are all
# that is available — never configuration and never secrets.
data "fleetdm_certificate_authorities" "all" {}

output "certificate_authority_names" {
  value = [for ca in data.fleetdm_certificate_authorities.all.certificate_authorities : ca.name]
}

# Look up a single certificate authority's id by name.
output "scep_wifi_id" {
  value = one([
    for ca in data.fleetdm_certificate_authorities.all.certificate_authorities :
    ca.id if ca.name == "SCEP_WIFI"
  ])
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certificate_authorities` (Attributes List) List of certificate authorities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificate_authorities))

<a id="nestedatt--certificate_authorities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificate_authorities`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the certificate authority.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate authority.
- `type` (String) Type of the certificate authority. One of `digicert`, `ndes_scep_proxy`, `custom_scep_proxy`, `custom_est_proxy`, `hydrant`, `smallstep`.
